spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes public ManaPool behavior for the whole workspace. It is not a preview, and nothing asks the seller again before SpellBook acts on the new mode.
Only the workspace owner may call it. An admin or member gets delegated_agent_workspace_owner_required.
Set a mode only after the seller chose it in their own words. Never pick one for them, and never read silence as a choice. New workspaces start on manual.
The response is the saved setting. Call spellbook_store_setup_status afterwards and tell the seller manapoolAutomation.meaning in plain words.
automatic sends nothing until the workspace passed a ManaPool test publish in the SpellBook web app and ManaPool reports the account ready. This tool cannot run that test publish.

assisted and automatic answer agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while SpellBook has agent marketplace writes switched off, the switch that also governs spellbook_manapool_sync_apply. manual and paused always save, so an agent can always pause ManaPool. Switching agent marketplace writes off later also stops an assisted or automatic an agent set earlier: SpellBook treats it as manual until the switch is back on or the seller picks a mode in the web app.
Only paused stops repricing of existing ManaPool listings. Only automatic sends quantity changes and delistings, so in every other mode a card that sold elsewhere can stay listed on ManaPool.

description: Set one workspace's ManaPool automation mode, which decides whether SpellBook creates, updates, delists, and reprices ManaPool listings by itself. This changes public ManaPool behavior for the workspace, only the workspace owner may call it, and the agent sets a mode only after the seller chose one. The modes: manual: SpellBook creates no ManaPool listings and sends no quantity changes or delistings, but it keeps repricing your existing ManaPool listings. assisted: SpellBook plans the ManaPool listing changes it would make but sends none of them and offers no approval step, and it keeps repricing your existing ManaPool listings. automatic: SpellBook creates, updates, and delists ManaPool listings as your inventory changes and reprices existing ones, once the workspace passed a ManaPool test publish and while ManaPool reports the account ready to sell. paused: SpellBook sends nothing to ManaPool: no new listings, no quantity changes, no delistings, and no repricing.

mode.description: The mode the seller chose: manual, assisted, automatic, or paused. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose ManaPool automation mode to set. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_manapool_automation_set
